speaker: john-the-baptist
text: After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: god
text: You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.
name: God the Father

speaker: jesus
text: The time is fulfilled,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Come, follow Me,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and I will make you fishers of men.
name: Jesus

speaker: unclean-spirit
text: What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!
name: The unclean spirit

speaker: jesus
text: Be silent!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Come out of him!
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!
name: The crowd

speaker: disciples
text: Everyone is looking for You!
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.
name: Jesus

speaker: leper
text: If You are willing, You can make me clean.
name: A leper

speaker: jesus
text: I am willing,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be clean!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Son, your sins are forgiven.
name: Jesus

speaker: scribes
text: Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?
name: The scribes

speaker: jesus
text: Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: We have never seen anything like this!
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Follow Me,
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Why does He eat with tax collectors and sinners?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.
name: Jesus

speaker: people
text: Why don’t Your disciples fast like John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees?
name: The people

speaker: jesus
text: How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them? As long as He is with them, they cannot fast.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, and a worse tear will result.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: During the high priesthood of Abiathar, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests. And he gave some to his companions as well.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore, the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Stand up among us.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Stretch out your hand.
name: Jesus

speaker: unclean-spirit
text: You are the Son of God!
name: The unclean spirit

speaker: family
text: He is out of His mind.
name: Jesus' family

speaker: scribes
text: He is possessed by Beelzebul,
name: The scribes

speaker: scribes
text: By the prince of the demons He drives out demons.
name: The scribes

speaker: jesus
text: How can Satan drive out Satan?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If a kingdom is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If a house is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself, he cannot stand; his end has come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Indeed, no one can enter a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can plunder his house.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, the sons of men will be forgiven all sins and blasphemies, as many as they utter.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of eternal sin.
name: Jesus

speaker: scribes
text: He has an unclean spirit.
name: The scribes

speaker: crowd
text: Look,
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Your mother and brothers are outside, asking for You.
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Who are My mother and My brothers?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Here are My mother and My brothers!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings, and they yielded no crop.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to those on the outside everything is expressed in parables,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: so that, ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The farmer sows the word.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Does anyone bring in a lamp to put it under a basket or under a bed? Doesn’t he set it on a stand?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Pay attention to what you hear. With the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and even more will be added to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For whoever has will be given more. But whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The kingdom of God is like a man who scatters seed on the ground.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Night and day he sleeps and wakes, and the seed sprouts and grows, though he knows not how.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All by itself the earth produces a crop—first the stalk, then the head, then grain that ripens within.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To what can we compare the kingdom of God? With what parable shall we present it?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds sown upon the earth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But after it is planted, it grows to be the largest of all garden plants and puts forth great branches, so that the birds of the air nest in its shade.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Let us cross to the other side.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Silence!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be still!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Why are you so afraid?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you still have no faith?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?
name: The disciples

speaker: demoniac
text: What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!
name: The demon-possessed man (Legion)

speaker: jesus
text: Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What is your name?
name: Jesus

speaker: demoniac
text: My name is Legion,
name: The demon-possessed man (Legion)

speaker: demoniac
text: for we are many.
name: The demon-possessed man (Legion)

speaker: demoniac
text: Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.
name: The demon-possessed man (Legion)

speaker: jesus
text: Go home to your own people,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jairus
text: My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.
name: Jairus

speaker: woman
text: If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.
name: The woman who was bleeding

speaker: jesus
text: Who touched My garments?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Daughter,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.
name: Jesus

speaker: jairus-messengers
text: Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?
name: Messengers from Jairus's house

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be afraid; just believe.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Talitha koum!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Little girl, I say to you, get up!
name: Jesus

speaker: nazareth-crowd
text: Where did this man get these ideas?
name: The people of Nazareth

speaker: nazareth-crowd
text: What is this wisdom He has been given? And how can He perform such miracles?
name: The people of Nazareth

speaker: nazareth-crowd
text: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?
name: The people of Nazareth

speaker: jesus
text: Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When you enter a house, stay there until you leave that area.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone will not welcome you or listen to you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that place, as a testimony against them.
name: Jesus

speaker: people
text: John the Baptist has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: He is Elijah,
name: The people

speaker: people
text: He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.
name: The people

speaker: herod
text: John, whom I beheaded, has risen from the dead!
name: Herod

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife!
name: John the Baptist

speaker: herod
text: Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.
name: Herod

speaker: herod
text: Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom!
name: Herod

speaker: herodias-daughter
text: What should I request?
name: Herodias's daughter

speaker: herodias
text: The head of John the Baptist.
name: Herodias

speaker: herodias-daughter
text: I want you to give me the head of John the Baptist on a platter immediately.
name: Herodias's daughter

speaker: jesus
text: Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late.
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: You give them something to eat.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Should we go out and spend two hundred denarii to give all of them bread to eat?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Go and see how many loaves you have,
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Five—and two fish.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders? Instead, they eat with defiled hands.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You have disregarded the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You neatly set aside the command of God to maintain your own tradition.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is Corban’ (that is, a gift devoted to God),
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: he is no longer permitted to do anything for his father or mother.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Thus you nullify the word of God by the tradition you have handed down. And you do so in many such matters.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All of you, listen to Me and understand:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Are you still so dull?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you not understand? Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: because it does not enter his heart, but it goes into the stomach and then is eliminated.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What comes out of a man, that is what defiles him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All these evils come from within, and these are what defile a man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: First let the children have their fill,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.
name: Jesus

speaker: syrophoenician
text: Yes, Lord,
name: The Syrophoenician woman

speaker: syrophoenician
text: even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.
name: The Syrophoenician woman

speaker: jesus
text: Because of this answer, you may go. The demon has left your daughter.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Ephphatha!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be opened!
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: He has done all things well! He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a great distance.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: How many loaves do you have?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Seven,
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Why does this generation demand a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Watch out!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Why are you debating about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Do you have such hard hearts?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear?’ And do you not remember?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Twelve,
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Seven,
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Do you still not understand?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Can you see anything?
name: Jesus

speaker: blind-man
text: I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.
name: The blind man

speaker: jesus
text: Do not go back into the village.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who do people say I am?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: But what about you?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who do you say I am?
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: You are the Christ.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Get behind Me, Satan! For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and for the gospel will save it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in His Father’s glory with the holy angels.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God arrive with power.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
name: Peter

speaker: god
text: This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!
name: God the Father

speaker: disciples
text: Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Elijah does indeed come first, and he restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you that Elijah has indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, just as it is written about him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What are you disputing with them?
name: Jesus

speaker: father
text: Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a spirit that makes him mute.
name: The boy's father

speaker: father
text: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.
name: The boy's father

speaker: jesus
text: O unbelieving generation!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How long has this been with him?
name: Jesus

speaker: father
text: From childhood,
name: The boy's father

speaker: father
text: It often throws him into the fire or into the water, trying to kill him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.
name: The boy's father

speaker: jesus
text: If You can?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All things are possible to him who believes!
name: Jesus

speaker: father
text: I do believe; help my unbelief!
name: The boy's father

speaker: jesus
text: You deaf and mute spirit,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I command you to come out and never enter him again.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: He is dead.
name: The crowd

speaker: disciples
text: Why couldn’t we drive it out?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: This kind cannot come out, except by prayer.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Son of Man will be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill Him, and after three days He will rise.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What were you discussing on the way?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone wants to be first, he must be the last of all and the servant of all.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever welcomes one of these little children in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes not only Me, but the One who sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: john-apostle
text: Teacher, we saw someone else driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.
name: John

speaker: jesus
text: Do not stop him,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For no one who performs a miracle in My name can turn around and speak evil of Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For whoever is not against us is for us.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Indeed, if anyone gives you even a cup of water because you bear the name of Christ, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: where ‘their worm never dies, and the fire is never quenched.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For everyone will be salted with fire.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with one another.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: What did Moses command you?
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Moses permitted a man to write his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Moses wrote this commandment for you because of your hardness of heart.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.
name: Jesus

speaker: rich-man
text: Good Teacher,
name: The rich man

speaker: rich-man
text: what must I do to inherit eternal life?
name: The rich man

speaker: jesus
text: Why do you call Me good?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one is good except God alone.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not cheat others, honor your father and mother.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Teacher,
name: Jesus

speaker: rich-man
text: all these I have kept from my youth.
name: The rich man

speaker: jesus
text: There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Who then can be saved?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: With man this is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Look, we have left everything and followed You.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake and for the gospel
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: who will mock Him and spit on Him and flog Him and kill Him. And after three days He will rise again.
name: Jesus

speaker: james-and-john
text: Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.
name: James and John

speaker: jesus
text: What do you want Me to do for you?
name: Jesus

speaker: james-and-john
text: Grant that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory.
name: James and John

speaker: jesus
text: You do not know what you are asking,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Can you drink the cup I will drink, or be baptized with the baptism I will undergo?
name: Jesus

speaker: james-and-john
text: We can,
name: James and John

speaker: jesus
text: You will drink the cup that I drink,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and you will be baptized with the baptism that I undergo.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.
name: Jesus

speaker: bartimaeus
text: Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!
name: Bartimaeus

speaker: bartimaeus
text: Son of David, have mercy on me!
name: Bartimaeus

speaker: jesus
text: Call him.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: Take courage!
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Get up! He is calling for you.
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: What do you want Me to do for you?
name: Jesus

speaker: bartimaeus
text: Rabboni,
name: Bartimaeus

speaker: bartimaeus
text: let me see again.
name: Bartimaeus

speaker: jesus
text: Go,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: your faith has healed you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go into the village ahead of you, and as soon as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it shortly.’
name: Jesus

speaker: bystanders
text: Why are you untying the colt?
name: Those standing there

speaker: crowd
text: Hosanna!
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Hosanna in the highest!
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: May no one ever eat of your fruit again.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Look, Rabbi! The fig tree You cursed has withered.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Have faith in God,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you that if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and has no doubt in his heart but believes that it will happen, it will be done for him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well.
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests
text: By what authority are You doing these things?
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: chief-priests
text: And who gave You the authority to do them?
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: jesus
text: I will ask you one question,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: John’s baptism—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me!
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests
text: If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: chief-priests
text: But if we say, ‘From men’...
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: chief-priests
text: We do not know.
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: jesus
text: Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then he sent them another servant, and they struck him over the head and treated him shamefully.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He sent still another, and this one they killed. He sent many others; some they beat and others they killed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Have you never read this Scripture: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Teacher,
name: The Pharisees

speaker: pharisees
text: we know that You are honest and seek favor from no one. Indeed, You are impartial and teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not? Should we pay them or not?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Why are you testing Me? Bring Me a denarius to inspect.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whose image is this? And whose inscription?
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Caesar’s,
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.
name: Jesus

speaker: sadducees
text: Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died, leaving no children.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: Then the second one married the widow, but he also died and left no children. And the third did likewise.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: In this way, none of the seven left any children. And last of all, the woman died.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: jesus
text: Aren’t you mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the Book of Moses, how God told him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!
name: Jesus

speaker: scribe
text: Which commandment is the most important of all?
name: A scribe

speaker: jesus
text: This is the most important: ‘Hear O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ No other commandment is greater than these.
name: Jesus

speaker: scribe
text: Right, Teacher,
name: A scribe

speaker: scribe
text: You have stated correctly that God is One and there is no other but Him,
name: A scribe

speaker: scribe
text: and to love Him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself, which is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.
name: A scribe

speaker: jesus
text: You are not far from the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Speaking by the Holy Spirit, David himself declared: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Watch out for the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, to receive greetings in the marketplaces,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and to have the chief seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more than all the others into the treasury.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciple
text: Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!
name: A disciple

speaker: jesus
text: Do you see all these great buildings?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: See to it that no one deceives you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So be on your guard. You will be delivered over to the councils and beaten in the synagogues. On My account you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say. Instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Let no one on the housetop go back inside to retrieve anything from his house.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Pray that this will not occur in the winter.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For those will be days of tribulation unmatched from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If the Lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So be on your guard; I have told you everything in advance.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But in those days, after that tribulation: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests
text: But not during the feast,
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: chief-priests
text: or there may be a riot among the people.
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: bystanders
text: Why this waste of perfume?
name: Those standing there

speaker: bystanders
text: It could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor.
name: Those standing there

speaker: jesus
text: Leave her alone; why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. But you will not always have Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: She has done what she could to anoint My body in advance of My burial.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go into the city, and a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and whichever house he enters, say to the owner, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is My guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And he will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, one of you who is eating with Me will betray Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Surely not I?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: It is one of the Twelve—the one who is dipping his hand into the bowl with Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed! It would be better for him if he had not been born.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Take it; this is My body.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, I will no longer drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You will all fall away, for it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Even if all fall away, I never will.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Sit here while I pray.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Abba, Father,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: all things are possible for You. Take this cup from Me. Yet not what I will, but what You will.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Simon, are you asleep?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Were you not able to keep watch for one hour?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Are you still sleeping and resting? That is enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Rise, let us go. See, My betrayer is approaching!
name: Jesus

speaker: judas
text: The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him and lead Him away securely.
name: Judas

speaker: judas
text: Rabbi!
name: Judas

speaker: jesus
text: Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me. But this has happened that the Scriptures would be fulfilled.
name: Jesus

speaker: false-witnesses
text: We heard Him say, ‘I will destroy this man-made temple, and in three days I will build another that is made without hands.’
name: False witnesses

speaker: high-priest
text: Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?
name: The high priest

speaker: high-priest
text: Are You the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?
name: The high priest

speaker: jesus
text: I am,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: high-priest
text: Why do we need any more witnesses?
name: The high priest

speaker: high-priest
text: You have heard the blasphemy. What is your verdict?
name: The high priest

speaker: guards
text: Prophesy!
name: The guards

speaker: servant-girl
text: You also were with Jesus the Nazarene.
name: A servant girl

speaker: peter
text: I do not know or even understand what you are talking about,
name: Peter

speaker: servant-girl
text: This man is one of them.
name: A servant girl

speaker: bystanders
text: Surely you are one of them, for you too are a Galilean.
name: Those standing there

speaker: peter
text: I do not know this man of whom you speak!
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times.
name: Jesus

speaker: pilate
text: Are You the King of the Jews?
name: Pilate

speaker: jesus
text: You have said so,
name: Jesus

speaker: pilate
text: Have You no answer? Look how many charges they are bringing against You!
name: Pilate

speaker: pilate
text: Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?
name: Pilate

speaker: pilate
text: What then do you want me to do with the One you call the King of the Jews?
name: Pilate

speaker: crowd
text: Crucify Him!
name: The crowd

speaker: pilate
text: Why?
name: Pilate

speaker: pilate
text: What evil has He done?
name: Pilate

speaker: crowd
text: Crucify Him!
name: The crowd

speaker: soldiers
text: Hail, King of the Jews!
name: The soldiers

speaker: passersby
text: Aha! You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days,
name: Those passing by

speaker: passersby
text: come down from the cross and save Yourself!
name: Those passing by

speaker: chief-priests
text: He saved others, but He cannot save Himself!
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: chief-priests
text: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and believe!
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: jesus
text: Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?
name: Jesus

speaker: bystanders
text: Behold, He is calling Elijah.
name: Those standing there

speaker: bystanders
text: Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down.
name: Those standing there

speaker: centurion
text: Truly this man was the Son of God!
name: The centurion

speaker: women
text: Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?
name: The women

speaker: angel
text: Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.
name: The young man in white

speaker: angel
text: But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you.’
name: The young man in white

speaker: jesus
text: Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In My name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: they will pick up snakes with their hands, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not harm them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be made well.
name: Jesus
